briefs.coreQuestion: How do you test role, aria-checked, disabled state, keyboard behavior, and visible state for email preference switches?

outline.heading: Accessible email preference switch tests: What Must the Suite Prove?
outline.purpose: Answer "How do you test role, aria-checked, disabled state, keyboard behavior, and visible state for email preference switches?" in 40 to 60 words, define the contract as email preference switches must expose role and aria-checked state, support keyboard activation, and reflect master-toggle disabled behavior visibly and semantically, and state the observable pass criteria.

outline.purpose: Trace request, helper, schema, component, and persistence ownership only through packages/web/src/app/dashboard/preferences/page.tsx:role switch controls; packages/web/src/components/ui/button.tsx:Button. Separate code-backed behavior from source-backed recommendations.

outline.purpose: Explain the normal path and compatibility boundaries for aria checked switch tests. Convert repository branches into named fixtures with complete observable outputs.

outline.purpose: Compare control, role, accessible name, aria-checked, disabled state, keyboard input, visual state, and saved value. Include the planned table, explain every row, and cite the repository source for each expected result.

outline.heading: How Should Keyboard switch accessibility Be Exercised?
outline.purpose: Build the harness for keyboard switch accessibility, identify which dependencies require real integration versus controlled doubles, and state the assertions that prevent false positives.

outline.heading: Step-by-Step Playwright preference switch test Procedure
outline.purpose: Present the numbered procedure for playwright preference switch test: Open authenticated preferences with known saved values. Locate controls by role and accessible name, then assert aria-checked and disabled state. Use Tab and Space to change allowed switches and prove disabled children do not change. Save, reload, and verify the accessible and persisted states remain aligned.

outline.heading: React role switch testing: Assertions and Diagnostics
outline.purpose: Cover react role switch testing with status, state, side-effect, call-count, and visible-output assertions. Explain the failure signal a CI report must retain.

outline.heading: What Regressions and Boundaries Prevent False Confidence?
outline.purpose: A color or position change is not enough; the browser test must assert semantics, keyboard behavior, and persistence. List nearby concerns owned by related articles and define the post-change cases that remain in scope.

outline.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
outline.purpose: Answer five to eight questions in 40 to 60 words each. Cover "How do you test role, aria-checked, disabled state, keyboard behavior, and visible state for email preference switches?" plus question variants based on aria checked switch tests, disabled notification toggle test, keyboard switch accessibility, playwright preference switch test, react role switch testing.

outline.heading: Conclusion
outline.purpose: Summarize the verified contract without introducing new claims, then use this CTA: Run the preference controls with keyboard-only input and add the switch matrix to the Playwright post-flow.
